comments.body:
Hey there! I did get the approval of a professor, but it seems like the university doesn't let anyone come for under 91 days. Here's an email they sent me:

"Stays by Bachelor's and Master's students for projects that cannot be credited and/or last less than 91 days are not possible. They cannot be registered either as guests or as mobility students. This also applies to unpaid internships."
comments.author: RumaliRotii
